text: Through MM16.31 from the March 2024 meeting of City Council, City Council directed City staff to report to North York Community Council on the status and progress of Metrolinx’s Ontario Line construction and the Province’s Transit-Oriented Communities projects within the boundaries of North York. This report provides project details and a status update on the three Ontario Line stations and a Transit-Oriented Communities proposal located in North York.

North York Community Council: 1. Received the report (October 10, 2024) from the Executive Director, Transit Expansion Division, and the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning, for information.
